description: DNS propagation check: resolves one record type for a domain across Cloudflare 1.1.1.1, Google 8.8.8.8 and Quad9 9.9.9.9 (DNS-over-HTTPS, in parallel) and reports consensus, per-resolver answers, TTLs, rcodes and differences. Price: $0.01 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: GET https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/dns-propagation

resolvers.description: Comma-separated subset of cloudflare,google,quad9 (default all three)

name: dns_propagation
title: Dns Propagation
